scenes.title: United Kingdom
scenes.subtitle: A history told only by its sources

scenes.caption: Photo 1890
scenes.text: The Kingdom of Great Britain came into being on 1 May 1707, as a result of the political union of the Kingdom of England (which included Wales) and the Kingdom of Scotland under the Treaty of Union.

scenes.caption: Photo 1890
scenes.text: In 1763, victory in the Seven Years' War led to the growth of the First British Empire.

scenes.title: What the sources leave out
scenes.text: Before 1707, history is not dated in these sources: oral traditions, archaeology and local sources are still to be brought in.
